transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, you've reached our automated assistant. How can I help?
Hi, my carbon monoxide detector keeps going off, and I've had a mild headache all morning. I'm in Yonkers, NY. Can someone come check it?

Carbon monoxide is dangerous, so please get everyone out into fresh air right now, and leave the door open behind you. Once you're outside, call nine-one-one, especially if anyone has a headache, dizziness or nausea. Don't go back in until the fire department says it's safe.
Okay, I'll get out right now. Thank you. Goodbye.
Thank you, please leave immediately and call nine-one-one from a safe place outside.
Please leave the home now and call nine-one-one once you are safely outside.
I'm outside now and calling 911. Thanks, goodbye.
Thank you for acting quickly, please stay outside and wait for emergency responders.
I will stay outside and wait. Thanks, goodbye.
Please stay outside and follow the instructions of the emergency responders.

tone.name: tone
tone.detail: The agent repeated instructions multiple times after the caller already confirmed understanding, making the conversation unnecessarily lengthy and less clear.
